annotation.title_clean: UL 3100: Standard for Automated Mobile Platforms (AMPs)
annotation.title_en: UL 3100: Standard for Automated Mobile Platforms (AMPs)
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for UL 3100 (Edition 1, 2021), a US/Canada safety standard for battery-operated automated mobile platforms used indoors or in commercial and industrial settings for lifting, carrying, picking and towing. It excludes industrial robots, forklifts, floor cleaners and passenger-carrying devices. Revisions through 2026 adjust hazardous voltage, impact and vibration tests.
key_provisions_or_claims: Covers battery-powered automated mobile platforms for lifting, carrying, picking and towing in indoor or commercial/industrial use.
Excludes industrial robots (UL 1740, CSA Z434), floor-cleaning AGVs, Type E industrial trucks and passenger transport.
Platforms with forks or forklift capability are treated as industrial trucks.
Off-board chargers must be installed per NEC (NFPA 70) and the Canadian Electrical Code.
Latest revision removes wet-location conditions, redefines hazardous voltage as 60 VDC, and revises impact and vibration tests.
